description: Converts Word documents (.docx, and old .doc through Word or LibreOffice) to Markdown, keeping headings, formatting, list numbering, the table of contents (as links to the headings), bookmarks and cross-references, tables with merged cells, footnotes, comments, tracked changes and images.
command.convert.title: Convert to Markdown
config.tables.description: How tables are written. `auto`: Markdown (GFM) tables, and HTML tables for those with merged cells or tables inside cells, which GFM cannot express.
config.tables.auto: GFM tables; HTML only where cells are merged or nested
config.tables.gfm: Always GFM tables (merged cells become empty cells)
config.trackedChanges.description: What to do with tracked changes (revisions) in the document.
config.trackedChanges.accept: Final text: insertions kept, deletions dropped
config.trackedChanges.reject: Original text: insertions dropped, deletions kept
config.comments.description: What to do with Word comments.
config.comments.footnotes: As footnotes with the author's name
config.imagesFolder.description: Folder for the document's images, next to the Markdown file. `{name}` is the document name without extension.
config.openAfterConversion.description: What to open after converting a single document.
config.openAfterConversion.editor: The Markdown file in the editor
config.libreOfficePath.description: Path to LibreOffice's `soffice` (`soffice.exe` on Windows), used for old `.doc` files when Word is not available. Empty: the standard install locations and `PATH`.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces: In Restricted Mode the LibreOffice path from workspace settings is ignored.
